text:
sophie: Heads up — we need to lock the API -> billing fields before sprint planning. Major asks from sales + a couple of enterprise customers landed this week.
chris: Can you summarize the open questions? I only have bandwidth to implement one policy shape this cycle.
maya: High level: token accounting rules for tool-calls/structured output, per-route quota surface (per-route + global), and embeddings pricing granularity.
oliver: Also rerank pricing — customers expect predictable cost when they send N candidates. Should be explicit in API fields.
eli: Proposed minimal schema (for the billing engine):
```json
{
  "route": "string",                // e.g. chat.completions, embeddings.encode, rerank",
  "billing_unit": "enum",          // token | request | vector
  "unit_multiplier": "number",     // tokens per billing unit (usually 1), or vector dims
  "token_accounting": "enum",      // prompt_only | prompt+completion | prompt+completion+tools
  "quota_scopes": ["string"],      // account, project, route
  "per_minute_limit": "number",
  "per_day_quota": "number",
  "candidate_billing": "enum"     // none | per_candidate | per_pairwise
}
```
chris: Quick notes: - token_accounting must cover KV/prefix cache exemptions (we should exclude cache hits) - tool calls: count both serialized call signature + tool output tokens IMO
maya: Customer ask: enterprise wants ability to set per-route quota caps (e.g. embeddings heavy routes capped) and also a secondary soft limit that triggers throttling but not billing stop.
oliver: For rerank: we should support candidate_billing=per_candidate and a separate pairwise mode for expensive scoring. That maps cleanly to predictable invoices.
pm-bot: @sophie added a follow-up doc link: https://redwood.internal/pricing/field-mappings (for reference)
sophie: Launch criteria suggestion:
- complete mapping JSON in API spec and console UI (developers can see cost implications)
- billing engine accepts new fields and passes unit tests
- migration plan for existing customers + opt-in window
- perf test for token counting with tool calls (accuracy within 1% of golden)
finance-bot: Need to agree on embeddings unit price shape this week. Proposal: price = base_request_fee + per_vector_dim * dims. Simpler to explain to customers.
eli: Edge cases to decide:
- are function/tool outputs counted in the model's completion tokens or as separate billing entries? (impacts accounting when external tool returns huge payload)
- structured outputs (JSON schema) — do we charge for schema tokens that are autogenerated vs user-provided content?
chris: My implement plan if approved:
1) extend route schema + API validation
2) add tokenizer hooks to count tool payloads and cached prefixes
3) support per-route soft limit that emits 429 with `x-quota-warning` header
4) billing export includes detailed per-route breakdown
maya: Prioritization: customer-driven enterprise per-route caps (high), token_accounting clarification (high), rerank candidate pricing (medium), vector-dim pricing (finance urgent but lower engineering complexity).
oliver: Can we land a minimal v1 that treats function outputs as completion tokens and add a toggle to treat them separately later? That would reduce scope.
sophie: Agree on v1 toggle approach. Action items:
- chris: draft API patch + example JSON by EOD Wed (1769992600)
- maya: collect 3 enterprise contract examples for per-route caps
- finance-bot: publish recommended embeddings price model to the doc
- eli: write unit tests for token counting edge cases
pm-bot: Rolling this into the roadmap epic: PRICING-1287
sophie: Thanks team — moving to async threads if more detail needed :thumbsup:
